asr.full_text: The cryptocurrency markets have been getting demolished lately. Bitcoin took a huge dump to sub $20k altcoins followed at an accelerated rate as they always do. DeFi's got wrecked. Ponzi's crumbled. Rebasing tokens went to the graveyard. Fake Nodes plummeted to oblivion, FTM lost it's founder, Celsius became insolvent, Terralluna absolutely crashed causing the highest APR stablecoin staking platform known to man to collapse. Coin bace decided to sell it's users information to the government causing mass hysteria, and now KuCoin is coming under scrutiny and fire as being potentially insolvent due to the Terralluna crash. Now, most of these things are true and some are open to interpretation. Is KuCoin really shutting down withdrawals and becoming insolvent due to the bank run that has ensued in precaution to the news? In this video you will find out exactly how this happened, the cause of this, the response from KuCoin itself, the future of KuCoin and my thoughts and two cents on this topic. Before we get into that, if you like this type of content make sure you smash that like button for me. If you find value that subscribe button is your best friend and BOOM! BANG on that notification bell so you can be alerted of stuff like this in the future. Let me know how you're feeling about this in the relevant comments section and thank you so much for the love and support. Now before we address the absolutely massive elephant in the room. Coo-Coin shutting down withdrawals let's put some context behind this conversation. So how did this happen? So what many would consider, and rightfully, so, some serious FUD which is fear uncertainty and doubt, happened over the weekend surrounding KuCoin and it's exchange withdraw mechanisms and solvency and solvency is the ability to pay out investors as principal balances without going out of business. A rather large Twitter influencer, MylesDeutscher with 142k followers took to Twitter and said this hearing some rumors that KuCoin could be halting withdraws in the near future… Apparently they suffered immensely from the luna collapse. If you have funds on Kucoin consider withdrawing them after all, it's better to be safe than sorry, given recent events So this post actually received over 2,500 likes and over 500 retweets this means that it reached way more than 142,000 people when you add up all the followers of the retweeters and the retweets on their posts respectively this becomes an absolute spiraling effect then everybody took to reddit and started going crazy in a bunch of threads about the speculation this reached widespread panic very quickly articles written, and within a couple of hours, I was already getting DMs in my private Discord, et cetera. So that leads us to this. What caused this to happen? This comes down to 100% market psychology, and this is something you need to familiarize yourself with. So there's this thing called manifesting, and another addition to that is the self-fulfilling prophecy. This essentially means that you can speak something into existence. The more someone sees something in their face, the more likely they are to believe it and react to it. The self-fulfilling prophecy comes next, where people have manifested this idea and spoken it into existence to the extent that the market participants start to act on it. Once the idea is planted and beat into people's heads, they start thinking. Hmm, is this real? Probably not, but why take the chance? I'm going to start withdrawing now. Then more people start to prove the prophecy right, because they start talking about withdrawing and witnessing others doing so. This is where the herd mentality kicks in and everyone else jumps on after the early movers. A cascade of news, sentiments, and withdraws ensues. and it forces KuCoin into a decision — let it happen, or do exactly what everyone said they were doing. It is very little known the reasoning behind the tweet or the Reddit articles but one thing is for sure, they linked it to the Terra Luna disaster. It really doesn't matter what caused it, what matters is that it happened. Touching back on the self fulfillingfulfilling prophecy the more the news gets picked up whether it is true or not the more people act and react if enough people talk about it it reaches the masses and it becomes take action time why take the chance so people started withdrawing in troves we will get more into that later the millions were taken out of the kucoin exchange in the matter of hours and trading volume suffered because of it so if that is the case how do you stop it? What was KuCoin's response to these allegations? So KuCoin obviously allowed withdrawals. Let's be real. I can confirm that because I was one of the play it safe people. Oh Drew, you're such a wuss. In a technical sense, maybe, but I have a lot of people depending on me to make good decisions. So this was a play it safe scenario where I would rather be safe than sorry. This literally what I did and I imagine many others did the same I pulled over a 1 million dollars out of KuCoin draining our balances just to be safe for Wolfer Finance I pulled out all of my funds for my personal KuCoin account as well I then posted in our private discord so that everyone knew we were being proactive now know this I am giving you the spark notes on this so pause and check the screenshots if you want the full quote, what i said was we have heard the KuCoin rumors and we are not taking any chances more than likely they are just that rumors, but with that being said we do not want to take a chance. Even though these may be drastic circumstances we are hyper vigilant about stuff like this so i would rather have the money in our treasury wallet than anywhere else. Just know we are always on top of these things and thank you to the community members that brought this up as well, and then it eventually led to this. I am pleased to confirm that one 100% of our funds have been taken out of KuCoin. That goes for all of our coins, all of our USDC, and all of our USDT. Everything is now in the treasury wallet and you can feel free to go check the treasury wallet on all of the different block explorers like ethereum, phantom, avalanche and matic everyone can sleep easy knowing we dont have any exposure to worry about and have a fun holiday weekend to all United states citizens that will be celebrating the fourth of July we know how we responded. How did kucoin respond? the first thing they did was not halt withdrawals but then they came out with twitter statements such as this beware of fuds not sure who is spreading these sheer rumors and what their intentions are thing they did was not halt withdrawals, but then they came out with twitter statements such as this Now put yourself in their position knowing what you know in what we just talked about, market pyschology, herd mentality, self fulfilling prophecy, manifestation, etc, you are the CEO of KuCoin, so what would you do? And KuCoin even reacted by saying that legal actions may be taken against the people online who incited this online riot and bank run. And if you don't know what a bank run is, you literally just saw it on Terraluna and UST, but here's what it is. It is basically when everybody runs to the bank to try to take all of their money out all at the same time the bank doesn't have enough cash on hand to give everybody their money and the bank has to shut down so with all of that taking into account what does the future hold for KuCoin? My guess is that the early adopters the first withdrawers like myself and Wolfer Finance will wait until the proverbial dust settles. my own group members brought these tweets up to me and said they think KuCoin will be okay and my response was this and I probably have a little credibility in saying this as a crypto institution founder and a business owner myself. that's exactly what I would say too if there was a bank run on my exchange. let's let the dust settle and we will revisit. believe half of what you see and even less of what you hear type stuff Here is my two cents on how this unfolded. Was it true? We never really know. Should you be safe and hyper vigilance? Absolutely. Well, being safe and vigilant actually fulfill the prophecy for itself It definitely could this is a slippery slope that we tread and navigate But all I can say is that I was not willing to bet a million dollars worth of Wolfer Finance investor funds on a gut intuition that this wasn't true. Sometimes it is better to be safe than sorry. And in this market, that is especially true. I personally hope that KuCoin survives this bank run. Truly, they are an integral part of this cryptocurrency ecosystem, my personal portfolio and Wolfer Finance in general. Everyone has to make their own decisions in the. With the information that they have at hand. So I don't think a business like KU coin. Would fault any of their customers. For just playing it safe. Even if it harmed KU coin in the interim. I do believe they came out on the other side of this. Will survive it. But I will be eagerly awaiting the conclusion on the sidelines. Until that proverbial dust settles. There's too much at stake. And only time will tell how this ends. So with that being said. If you liked liked this content make sure you smash that like button for me make sure you hit subscribe boom bang on that notification bell comment anything that you want in the relevant sections thank you so much for showing up to the video thank you for the love and support I hope to see you in the next one have a good day everyone
